extensions.name: ask_user
extensions.description: Stops and asks you 1-4 multiple-choice questions when gatto needs a decision it cannot make itself.

extensions.name: web_search
extensions.description: Searches the web and fetches pages as readable text. Providers are configured in gatto.json.

extensions.name: undo
extensions.description: Snapshots a file before every write the tools make, and /undo puts one back.

extensions.name: cards
extensions.description: Writes a role file from a Character Card V2 or V3, and /card <path> runs it.

extensions.name: tasks
extensions.description: Reads and writes the task store of the project gatto opened, through the store's own rules.
